items.html: And know that the whole of this phase of image is one name, called HaVaYaH, for the Mochin of Gadlut are called HaVaYaH, and understand this. And the first three letters, which are Yod-Hey-Vav, are called the three letters of Tzelem [image], and the last Hey is called Demut [likeness]. And this is the secret of “let us make man in our image, after our likeness.” And the whole of Tzelem and Demut is a complete man, comprising ZON, which are the letters Yod-Hey-Vav together with the last Hey.
